titulo: Mar na frente, exército atrás. Deus abriu caminho 🙏
estilo_imagem: cinematic photorealistic epic film still, dramatic volumetric god rays, floating dust particles, deep chiaroscuro, ancient Egypt and the Sinai desert by the Red Sea, muted earthy tones, vertical 9:16
prefixo_video: Cinematic epic film shot, slow and subtle motion.
epoca_imagem: Late Bronze Age Egypt and the Sinai shore of the Red Sea, ancient Egyptian war chariots, goat-hair tents, stone, clay, bronze, wood and cloth only, nothing modern

cenas.trecho: Mar na frente, exército atrás. Assim estava Israel, recém-saído da escravidão no Egito.
cenas.prompt_imagem: epic high aerial view at dusk of a vast desert shore, a dark stormy sea in front, a wide camp of tiny distant tents by the water, a long cloud of dust rising from approaching chariots on the horizon behind
cenas.prompt_movimento: slow aerial camera glide over the shore, waves roll, the dust cloud on the horizon drifts closer

cenas.trecho: Faraó mandou seiscentos carros escolhidos atrás deles, para trazer seus escravos de volta.
cenas.prompt_imagem: wide high view of rows of ancient Egyptian war chariots with bronze fittings and painted wooden wheels on a desert plain, Egyptian temple pylons far behind, golden dust in the air
cenas.prompt_movimento: golden dust swirls in the light, banners flutter in the wind, slow camera push-in

cenas.trecho: Acampados junto ao mar, os israelitas viram os egípcios chegando e ficaram apavorados.
cenas.prompt_imagem: high-angle view of goat-hair tents and small campfires on a narrow beach between rugged mountains and the sea at nightfall, torches glowing far away in the distance on the desert
cenas.prompt_movimento: campfire flames flicker, tent cloth moves in the wind, distant torches shimmer, slow camera descent

cenas.trecho: Disseram a Moisés: Era melhor servir aos egípcios do que morrer no deserto.
cenas.prompt_imagem: abandoned clay bricks and a straw mold lying on cracked dry earth in the desert at sunset, broken clay pots, long shadows
cenas.prompt_movimento: dry dust blows slowly across the bricks, sunset light glows, slow camera push-in

cenas.trecho: Moisés respondeu: Não tenham medo. Fiquem firmes. O Senhor lutará por vocês.
cenas.prompt_imagem: a weathered wooden shepherd's staff planted upright in the sand on a desert shore, the dark sea beyond, a single beam of light breaking through storm clouds
cenas.prompt_movimento: the beam of light grows stronger, clouds move slowly, waves roll behind, slow camera push-in

cenas.trecho: A coluna de nuvem passou para trás, entre os dois acampamentos, durante a noite.
cenas.prompt_imagem: epic wide night view of a towering column of dark cloud glowing from within, standing between a desert camp with tiny distant campfires and the plain behind, moonlit sea
cenas.prompt_movimento: the cloud column churns slowly, inner light pulses gently, campfires flicker, slow camera rise

cenas.trecho: Moisés estendeu a mão sobre o mar. Um forte vento oriental soprou a noite inteira.
cenas.prompt_imagem: a hand holding a wooden staff stretched out over a wild dark sea at night, strong wind whipping the waves and sea spray, storm clouds
cenas.prompt_movimento: strong wind blows the sea spray, waves churn, clouds race across the sky, slow camera push-in

cenas.trecho: As águas se abriram. Israel passou em terra seca, entre paredes de água.
cenas.prompt_imagem: epic high aerial view of a dry seabed path through the middle of the sea, towering walls of water on both sides glowing in moonlight, a long line of tiny distant travelers crossing
cenas.prompt_movimento: the water walls ripple and shimmer, spray drifts in the wind, slow aerial camera glide forward along the path

cenas.trecho: Os carros egípcios entraram atrás, mas as rodas emperraram. Ao amanhecer, o mar voltou.
cenas.prompt_imagem: a broken wooden chariot wheel stuck in wet mud on the seabed at dawn, towering walls of water starting to collapse in the background, pale golden light
cenas.prompt_movimento: the walls of water crash slowly, spray fills the air, dawn light grows, slow camera pull-back

cenas.trecho: Naquele dia o Senhor salvou Israel. E o povo creu. Êxodo, capítulo catorze.
cenas.prompt_imagem: wide view of a calm sea at sunrise from a desert shore, golden god rays through the clouds, gentle waves on the sand, tiny distant tents on the beach
cenas.prompt_movimento: golden sunrise light spreads over the water, gentle waves wash the sand, slow camera rise

cenas.trecho: Mar na frente, exército atrás? Fique firme. O Senhor ainda luta por você.
cenas.prompt_imagem: a path of wet sand leading from the sea toward bright sunrise light over the desert mountains, the shepherd's staff lying on the sand, volumetric golden light
cenas.prompt_movimento: the golden light grows brighter, waves wash softly over the path, slow camera push-in toward the light

legenda:
Senhor, abre caminho onde eu não vejo saída 🙏🌊
Êxodo 14:10-31
Comente "Amém" se você precisa que Deus lute por você hoje.
